title: Naver Webtoon, Munpia Launch 'World's Largest Web Novel Contest'
content: Naver WEBTOON and Korean web novel platform Munpia announced on Monday the launch of the 2026 "World's Largest Web Novel Contest," offering a total prize pool of 380 million won (approximately US$258,000) as the companies seek to discover and support the next generation of web novel creators.
